subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: Should this Control UI zh-CN localization work remain an umbrella for curated slice PRs, or should maintainers fold it into a broader i18n coverage program instead?
rationale: The remaining source problem is real, but the exact scope and wording are product/localization decisions and several overlapping open PRs already compete for the same generated locale surfaces.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Curate Slices
options.body: Keep this issue open as the tab-interior Control UI umbrella and review the existing slice PRs for generated i18n correctness, proof, and conflicts.

options.title: Fold Into Broad i18n Coverage
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88570 the broader canonical item and close this only after preserving the tab-specific evidence there.

options.title: Consolidate In One Maintainer PR
options.body: Pause the contributor slices and land a maintainer-owned generated sync that covers the reported tabs in one pass.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Curate Slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the tab-interior Control UI umbrella and review the existing slice PRs for generated i18n correctness, proof, and conflicts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merger/adjacent owner for the current UI/i18n files and best positioned from the available history to choose the review direction.
